name: IIT Bombay (Mathematics)
evidence: IIT Bombay's official Institute Vision & Mission page states that “IIT Bombay, an Institute of National Importance established by an Act of Parliament”; the supplied Mathematics subdomain identifies the Department of Mathematics at IIT Bombay.
notes: The supplied official Mathematics page was verified at https://www.math.iitb.ac.in/index.php.
Normal TLS verification produced the managed proxy error “self signed certificate in certificate chain”; curl --insecure was used only for public GET requests to the expected official hostnames.
